summary.text: Integrating sparse variational Gaussian process inference with the Kolmogorov-Arnold network topology enables scalable Bayesian inference and principled uncertainty quantification for regression tasks. Standard implementations of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks lack principled uncertainty quantification capabilities essential for scientific applications. By employing inducing points and analytic moment matching, computational complexity can be reduced while preserving interpretability for uncertainty-aware flow field reconstruction and regression.

target_user.text: Academic institutions and corporate R&D entities publishing patents or repositories involving Gaussian process regression and neural architectures.

jtbd.text: To perform uncertainty-aware regression and flow field reconstruction from sparse measurements while distinguishing aleatoric from epistemic uncertainty.

value_prop.text: Enables scalable Bayesian inference with computational complexity quasi-linear in sample size for Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, maintaining interpretability and providing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates.

riskiest_assumption.text: Analytic moment matching across deep additive Kolmogorov-Arnold network structures can accurately approximate full Gaussian process posteriors without prohibitive error propagation or scaling bottlenecks, given a score of F: 3.0 on the feasibility axis.

mvp.text: A technical proof of concept combining existing sparse Gaussian process packages with Kolmogorov-Arnold network implementations to evaluate predictive error and uncertainty calibration on a standard synthetic regression benchmark.
mvp.type: technical proof of concept from existing packages

success_metric.text: Achieving a proposed threshold of less than 0.05 calibration error and a test RMSE comparable to standard Gaussian process regressors on held-out sparse benchmark datasets.

kill_criteria.text: Proposed threshold: computation time scales worse than quadratic relative to sample size N during sparse variational optimization.
Proposed threshold: epistemic uncertainty estimates fail to correlate with out-of-distribution error, exhibiting an area under the ROC curve below 0.60.

open_source.use: Used for evaluating and calibrating uncertainty estimates generated by the sparse variational Gaussian process Kolmogorov-Arnold network model.
Provides foundational machine learning utilities and algorithmic components to support regression modeling workflows.

to_build.text: An analytic moment-matching propagation module tailored for edge-wise univariate functions in Kolmogorov-Arnold network topologies combined with sparse Gaussian process inducing points.
